text:
Anna P (People Ops): quick q — i'm planning a 60% parental leave for an international adoption starting Apr 18. can we convert up to 40h of accrued PTO into a one-time caregiver stipend to cover childcare/backfill for the first 2 weeks? who do I loop in for payroll + benefits approval?
Sam L (People Ops Lead): we do occasional accrual->stipend conversions for adoptions. requires manager sign-off + payroll form. cc @payroll-bot and @Benefits Team. pls include dates and number of hours.
Jordan M (Eng Manager): happy to sign. anna, can you DM me the exact leave window and the coverage plan so i can approve?
Anna P (People Ops): thx jordan — leaving Apr 18 to Jun 10 (approx), planning 60% FTE. want to convert 40h into stipend. coverage: two-week overlap with contractor + oncall shift swap.
payroll-bot: form link -> https://intranet.redwood/payroll/forms/accrual-conversion. Fill "Accrual Conversion Request" and pick "Caregiver stipend". deadline: submit >=10 days before leave start. Steps:
```
1) Employee fills form
2) Manager approves in form workflow
3) People Ops verifies eligibility
4) Payroll applies CARE-STIP payroll code on next cycle
```
payroll-bot: note — stipend is processed as supplemental taxable income; it cannot be PTO payout. max hours = accrual balance at time of request.
Benefits Team: FYI re: benefits continuity — health/dental remain active while on approved 60% parental leave; dependent benefits unaffected. stipend is taxable and may affect gross for FSA eligibility; we'll confirm with benefits coordinator after form.
Anna P (People Ops): quick follow-up — if international visa processing pushes adoption past Apr 18, can we shift the stipend window without reapplying?
Sam L (People Ops Lead): yes, we can shift dates as long as you update the form and cc payroll. if the delay >90 days we'll re-evaluate eligibility and amounts.
Jordan M (Eng Manager): i'll pre-approve pending final dates. once anna updates the form i'll hit approve. :thumbsup:
Anna P (People Ops): thanks everyone. i'll fill the form now and post the final dates here. attaching tentative details below for payroll copy-paste:
```
Employee: Anna P
Leave start (tentative): 2024-04-18
Leave end (tentative): 2024-06-10
Leave type: Parental - International Adoption
Hours to convert: 40
Requested stipend: caregiver support
Coverage plan: contractor 2w overlap + oncall shift swap (sam/jordan)
```
Sam L (People Ops Lead): perfect. ping me when submitted and i'll do the People Ops verification. :white_check_mark:
Jordan M (Eng Manager): thx, will coordinate handoffs with eng team.
Benefits Team: recorded — will follow up on FSA/tax note if needed.
Anna P (People Ops): submitted form and DM'd dates to jordan. thanks all!
